text:
Samira (People Ops): Evan mentioned wanting a phased return and a laptop docking station for working from the office a few days/week after parental leave. Quick thread to confirm options: phased schedule types, equipment stipend, and lactation room access.

Evan: Start leave 2026-12-01 for ~14 weeks. Planning to do a 6-week full leave, then a 4-week phased return at 50% (3 days/week), then fully back. Would like a desk + dock setup for the days I come in, and access to a nearby lactation room. Also wondering how PTO accrual interacts with phased return.

Ruth (Manager): Sounds reasonable. Team can cover async work during full leave; I can reassign meetings during phased weeks so Evan's 3 days are focused. On equipment: we can request a dock + monitor loaner from facilities. On PTO: payroll team confirms accrual rules.

Samira (People Ops): Policy notes: Redwood offers a one-time "new parent equipment stipend" $300 for home office gear (covers dock/monitor). For office equipment, Facilities can loan a dock/monitor; submit a ticket. Phased return guidance: managers may offer reduced hours or reduced days for up to 8 weeks; document the plan in the HR portal before leave starts. For PTO accrual: if you remain on payroll and under partial leave, you continue to accrue at your standard rate; full unpaid weeks pause accrual.

payroll-bot: PTO accrual rule: Full unpaid leave weeks suspend accrual. Partial paid leave weeks continue accrual per payroll policy. For specific calculations see payroll FAQ link: https://internal/payroll/leave-accrual.

Evan: I'll take the stipend and also request an office dock loaner. Ruth, can you mark the phased schedule in our calendar and block meeting-free days? I'll submit the HR phased-return form by 2026-11-20.

Ruth (Manager): Done. Marked phased return 2027-01-15 -> 2027-02-11 at 3 days/week. I'll move recurring meetings. Please put the handoff doc in the team drive.

facilities-bot: Equipment request created: EQ-20261115-88. Dock + 27" monitor reserved for Evan for 60 days post-return. Pickup window: 2027-01-15 to 2027-02-15.

Samira (People Ops): Great. Action items: Evan upload phased-return form by 2026-11-20; Facilities ticket reserved; Evan elect equipment stipend in HR portal if buying personal gear; manager to confirm meeting reductions. If anything else ping me and I'll add to the leave packet. :white_check_mark:
